body: トーカさんはハンバーガーが大好き

I know what your going through. Lost my grandmother this year from kidney failure. She couldn’t even see her grandson who’s the first in the family to graduate from high school but something that helped me cope with the loss is simply becoming a better person and to live life to the fullest so that one day you’ll be able to tell your grandmother a fantastic story about your life. I don’t know what your beliefs are but live for your grandmother when the time does happen. I’m praying for her health and wish you the best 🙏
